_README: Engineer-to-project mapping. The Aggregation Engine reads this to know who to expect JIRA activity from on each project. Reload requires an app restart (Phase 1). Keys starting with '_' are documentation only — the loader ignores them.
_help_engineers: Master list of every engineer who appears on any project. 'name' must match what JIRA returns in the user's displayName field. 'knox_id' must match JIRA's 'name' field on the user object (the actual username — NOT the 'key' field which is JIRAUSERxxxxx auto-generated). Replace these examples with your real engineers.
_help_assignments: Which engineers are on which projects. Each assignment lists project codes that MUST match config.json's projects[].code values exactly (case-insensitive). One engineer can be on multiple projects. Replace these examples to match your real org.
